applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term, audit job number and audit type (final, interim, revision, non-compliant)
Each GL exposure: class code, location/state, basis type (payroll, sales, area, units), estimated and audited basis
Whether Products-Completed Operations applies; limits (each occurrence / aggregate)
Expected premium and direction vs premium shown
Mid-term changes (class added/removed, location or limit change) and dates; keyed by auditor or automation; screenshots
title: Non-compliant (estimated) GL audit premium is wrong
symptoms: GL premium rose far more than the 10% basis uplift
Non-compliant GL audit produces a return premium
cause: A custom rule uplifts each exposure's estimated basis (here +10%). Defects: uplift compounded per slice or exposure, applied after ILF/modifiers, applied to the wrong base, or the minimum/deposit premium not respected.
diagnosis: Check the uplift base for each exposure and slice
Recompute the expected estimated premium including minimums
resolution: Re-run the audit with the uplift applied once to each exposure's annual estimated basis (revised audit)
workaround: Manual estimate approved by Premium Audit.
permanent_fix: Configurable uplift rule: once per exposure, before ILF and modifiers, never a return premium, respecting minimum/deposit premium.
escalation: PC L3 Rating & Audit with the Premium Audit business owner.
